title: Per-task README audit coverage
summary: Expose whether each requested reader or agent validation ran and what happened, with an explicit result for coverage the validator could not exercise.
acceptance_criteria: Distinguish passed, failed, skipped, and unsupported tasks in the report.
A required first-use action that did not run remains incomplete, and unsupported rendered navigation is visible.
Record the relevant source SHA and task evidence so readers can review the outcome.

evidence.claim: The active plan tracks rich-text navigation coverage and missing required first-use verification.
